findings.note: The session-law page for Chapter 135 of 2024, 'An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws' (original bill H.4885), ends with the line 'Approved, July 25, 2024.' The act covers serial numbers on firearms, untraceable guns, a list of banned assault-style firearms, and firearm safety courses.

Statement issued in her name on the 2024 gun law, as quoted by Boston.com in an October 2026 explainer; the same article quotes her saying the law cracks down on ghost guns and 3-D printed weapons and enhances the ability to prevent guns from falling into dangerous hands. The date of the statement is not shown on the page.

findings.passage: I think that our gun laws should stay in place, that's a big difference in this race
findings.note: Quoted by NBC Boston on her plan to vote yes on Question 9 (keep the 2024 gun law); date is the article's publication date.

findings.passage: The gun industry has openly defied our laws here in Massachusetts for nearly two decades.
findings.note: As Attorney General she said this in a statement announcing enforcement of the state's assault weapons ban against copycat weapons; quoted by WBUR, date is the article date.
